connecting: Connecting to the local storage service…
offlineBody:
This service is provided by the SiYuan fnOS app.
If SiYuan runs on a NAS, make sure that app is running.
If you are using the desktop client, enter the NAS with port 6806,
e.g. http://192.168.1.10:6806/localfs
wrongAppHint: , not the Local Storage service - Local Storage lives under /localfs; use the /localfs address above
embedFileToDoc: Embed a local file into the document
pickFileTitle: Pick a file to embed (click a folder to enter; use the right button to embed the whole folder)
embedNotCustom: Insert failed: the kernel did not create a custom block
textTruncated: The content is long; only the first 512 KB is shown.
baseUrlDesc:
Empty = auto detect (same-origin /localfs, then same-origin root).
The desktop client cannot detect the remote host - enter the NAS on port 6806,
e.g. http://192.168.1.10:6806/localfs
(6806 is the only externally reachable port - the tunnel maps just this one, and the Office login session is injected on the same path)
favoritesDesc:
Empty = show every storage space on this machine; filled = show only the folders below.
Click "Add folder" to tick several directories at once.
selNone: No folder selected yet (tick the boxes on the left; multi-select is allowed)
pickVolumeHint: Pick a storage space, then drill down to the folder you want
fnosCredDesc:
Office / PDF files are opened by FeiNiu official "Office Documents", which requires a FeiNiu login session.
Click Sync while your browser is signed in to FeiNiu (zero input, no password is read).
The desktop client opens a web page to do this (it takes you to the FeiNiu sign-in if needed).
credNone: Not synced yet - desktop Office will report not signed in
credNoCred: No FeiNiu session found - sign in to FeiNiu in your browser, then click again
credNoBase: NAS address unknown - fill in the service URL above and click Test first
credBrowserWait: Browser opened - finish the sync there (sign in to FeiNiu first if needed)…
credWaitTimeout: No result yet - did you finish the step in the browser? Click Test to re-check
credPopupBlocked: The browser blocked the popup - open this address to finish the sync:
